title: boardwise footprint library sample — one differential case input
description: A declared sample of .epru record text. The input carries no expected projection: both runners derive boardwise.footprint-library/1 from the text. No pinKey: a FOOTPRINT document is addressed by its own uuid, and the projection is that uuid's META title and nothing else.

text.x-meaning: The .epru record stream verbatim: {envelope}||{body}| lines, terminator optional on the last line.
